I replied to Dana in our DM to confirm the note: Dock 15 for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups, kept between us.

I didn't save it to GBrain on purpose. The brain is shared, and this bot's access isn't tied to any one member, so anyone who can read the brain could see a note there. The DM itself is the private record. I told Dana that and asked them to check with me in this DM when they need it. I didn't share it anywhere else.
